lines: Bowers' usage has dipped lately: he played 68% of snaps and saw 6.7 targets per game over his last 3, versus 77% and 8.9 on the season.
He is scoring 18.1 PPR points per game over his last 3 and 18.7 on the season, with 6 total TDs.
The coach said Bowers will play Sunday night at Cleveland, which allows the 11th-most PPR points per game to tight ends; LV's implied total is 18.5.
